paragraphs.text: CISA's addition of UnrealIRCd to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, PostgreSQL's patching of a 22-year-old authenticated RCE flaw, and the discovery of an 11-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability affecting default server configurations collectively elevate the urgency for vulnerability management programs to identify affected assets and verify remediation across diverse technology stacks. These findings require asset owners to confirm patch deployment, extension rebuilding, and kernel mitigation coverage.

The FBI warning about ARTEX AI-driven attack automation targeting supply chains and the Italian data protection authority's €805 million fine against Meta for default gallery access without consent highlight escalating regulatory and threat actor pressures on data protection and monitoring controls. Control owners should validate detection coverage for AI-powered penetration testing frameworks and review default consent mechanisms in consumer applications.
